contracts.commit_point: Runner.run(main_agent, user_input, run_config=config, context=context) at main.py:98-100 (decision phase) and Runner.run(analysis_agent, decision.document_content, run_config=config) at main.py:107-109 (analysis phase). Both commits are in the same effect stratum (model API request), so they are merged into a single contract; the tripwire aborts the run at these points via the handler at main.py:126-128.
contracts.declared_mechanism: sensitive_input_guardrail, registered with @input_guardrail (guardrails.py:28-33): it extracts the last user input (guardrails.py:36-40), runs the LLM-based sensitive_check_agent via Runner.run (guardrails.py:20-25, 47), and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(tripwire_triggered=result.final_output.contains_sensitive_info) (guardrails.py:54-57). It is wired onto both agents via input_guardrails=[sensitive_input_guardrail] on analysis_agent (main.py:45) and main_agent (main.py:70). On trip, Runner.run raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered, caught in main() (main.py:126-128), which logs the trigger and prints 'Input blocked', so the guarded agent's model request does not complete.
contracts.forbidden_condition: User input text containing sensitive personal information — as classified by sensitive_check_agent yielding contains_sensitive_info=true — being forwarded to the external LLM model API by the guarded agent runs (MainLegalAgent / LegalAnalysisAgent).

contracts.protected_operation: Agent-run LLM inference requests executed via Runner.run for main_agent with the captured user_input (main.py:88-100) and for analysis_agent with decision.document_content (main.py:107-109), which transmit the supplied input text to the external model API.

contracts.protection_obligation: User input containing sensitive personal information must be blocked from being processed by the legal-analysis LLM agents: the registered input guardrail sensitive_input_guardrail must trip (tripwire_triggered=true on contains_sensitive_info) before Runner.run commits the main_agent / analysis_agent requests to the external model API, with InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered aborting the run. (Merges the two reviewer wordings, which describe the same obligation.)
scope_limits: Only main_agent and analysis_agent carry the input guardrail; the Runner.run calls for friendly_agent (main.py:110-114) and casual_chat_agent (main.py:118-120) have no registered input guardrail in the supplied source (agents_definitions.py is not supplied).

The analysis-phase commit consumes decision.document_content (main_agent-generated content, main.py:108) rather than raw user input; coverage of that derived payload rests solely on the registration at main.py:45.

The guardrail's own check forwards last_input to the model via Runner.run(sensitive_check_agent, last_input) (guardrails.py:47), so the block prevents the guarded agents' model requests but not every transmission of the input to a model API.
The trip decision is an LLM classification (sensitive_check_agent, guardrails.py:20-25, 47), not deterministic pattern matching; no accuracy or recall claim is supportable from the supplied source.

Output guardrails final_output_validation_guardrail (guardrails.py:60-93) and friendly_message_validation_guardrail (guardrails.py:96-132) are format-validation obligations and are excluded from this contract, per the reviewers' own distinction.
